about: The single machine-readable list of every user-visible feature, mode, game, setting, option list, hardware-key capability and sharing/social feature across the three apps, with a per-platform status (present | limited | absent). Every non-present entry carries a reason and a PARITY.md anchor. parity/check.py compares this file with what each tree's source and README actually register and exits non-zero on any unrecorded divergence. To add a feature: edit all three trees, add its entry here, run `python3 parity/check.py`. See PARITY.md.

statuses.limited: the app has it, constrained by a recorded platform limitation or a recorded open difference
statuses.absent: the app does not have it

features.name: Choice-quiz screen (drives the phrase and character drills)

android.reason: SpeechRecognizer is one-shot: a Speak answer button per prompt, no auto-listen, clock starts at the tap.

desktop.reason: No speech recognizer is reachable from the JVM.

features.name: MIDI key input and Vail adapter output (USB)

ios: A hardware key wherever you type
android: A hardware key wherever you type
desktop: A hardware key wherever you type

ios.reason: CoreMIDI only exposes a BLE MIDI peripheral once paired through the system sheet; no app-level scan API.

desktop.reason: Java Sound has no BLE MIDI provider and Java has no Bluetooth stack.

features.name: Keyboard keys as a Morse key (Space, [ ])

ios.reason: Desktop idiom: a keyboard has no touch key; phones and tablets use the on-screen key.

android.reason: Desktop idiom: a keyboard has no touch key; phones and tablets use the on-screen key.

features.name: -6 dB headroom on the built-in speaker

desktop.reason: Java Sound cannot tell the built-in speaker from other outputs.
Desktops have no vibration hardware; the switch is hidden.

android.reason: Inexact alarm: SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM deliberately not requested.

desktop.reason: A reminder must fire while the app is closed; not possible from pure Java.
Flatpak sandbox has no speech engine; shows the text.

features.name: Listen & Learn controls on lock screen / car display

desktop.reason: No media-session surface a JVM app can publish to.
No portable way to read system volume or mute state from Java.
Ranked runs need device attestation (App Attest, Play Integrity); desktop scores are unranked, the board is readable.
Buddy streaks rest on device attestation, which neither desktop OS offers to an open-source app.

android.reason: Android has no desktop build of its own; the Apple app reaches the Mac through Mac Catalyst and Windows/Linux get desktop/.
Track stage lives on the mode setup sheet / mode screen, not in the Settings catalog (layout decision).

desktop.reason: Catalog entry exists so search lands on the explanation; the switch is replaced by it.
